definitions.hamstring portion of adductor magnus mus: A muscle head that originates from the ischial tuberosity and descends almost vertically through the posterior compartment of the thigh to insert by a rounded tendon onto the adductor tubercle of the medial femoral condyle. It is the ischiocondylar division of the adductor magnus, is innervated by the tibial division of the sciatic nerve, and acts to extend the hip joint.
